name: Aravindaksha
reason: aravinda lotus + akṣa eye; lotus-eyed, Vishnu epithet; IAST and Devanagari agree, no ē/ō/f

name: Vishvambhar
reason: viśvambhara, sustainer of the world; attested boy's name (Chaitanya's birth name); IAST and Devanagari agree

name: Mayureshwar
reason: suitable Ganesha name (mayūra peacock + īśvara lord) but meaning_en is circular; IAST and Devanagari agree

fix.meaning_en: Lord of the peacock; name of Ganesha at Morgaon

name: Shaktivel
reason: Tamil vēl (spear) plus Sanskrit śakti; hybrid but well-used Murugan name; IAST śaktivela has no ē and agrees with Devanagari; meaning_en reworded, etymology of the hybrid compound partly uncertain

fix.meaning_en: Spear of power; Murugan's divine spear
